text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It seems a great many people have turned out to root for me today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And that reporter who often writes about me is among them.
choice_data_list: Go show them the new you!
Go show them the new you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My determination and steadfast progress… I'll show them all what I can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ready to go, Grass Wonder leaves the waiting room beaming with energy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe. Let's have a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so glad I ran into you before the race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow… Spe, you're stiff as a board.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Remember, only those recognized and elected by the fans are able to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Plenty of people have come here to support you today, so why not take pride in that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ha ha… Yeah, I do really appreciate their support.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But, with you and the others here, I feel like I'm so, so out of my league.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's that time already! We have to go!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's both go out there and give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You can accomplish anything if you put your mind to it. But you'll accomplish nothing if you don't try.
